title: Elux Firerose 5000 Fizzy Gummy 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Fizzy Gummy from the Elux Firerose 5000 collection combines the fruity sweetness of gummy confectionary with the effervescent touch of fizzy sherbet. This e-liquid offers a nostalgic confectionary experience, perfect for those who enjoy sugary-sweet vape flavours. The smooth inhale delivers the fruity and chewy taste of gummy confectionary, while the exhale brings a fizzy sherbet twist, creating a unique and enjoyable vaping experience. The interplay of fruity gummy and fizzy sherbet notes makes this flavour a sweet vape treat. With a 50VG/50PG blend, Berry Bang ensures a perfectly balanced vape that’s ideal for those who enjoy both intense flavour and satisfying yet discreet cloud production. The Nicotine Salt formulation provides a silky smoothness of the vape and is suitable for use in any MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping device. Discover the delicious world of Elux Firerose 5000 Nic Salt e-liquids. This captivating range is inspired by some of Elux’s most popular disposable vape flavours, offering the same intensity of flavour but with the versatility and convenience that comes from 10ml bottles for use with a wide variety of vape devices. Experience all dozen delicious Elux Firerose flavours available at Vapestore.
